problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Kadu Malleshwara (2019–2022)
problem_summary: 9 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Kadu Malleshwara between January 2019 and August 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 22% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 16 pothole complaints.
24 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹33.3 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).
Ward recorded 125 road crashes in 2024, of which 16 were fatal.

agency_attribution_note: 9 of 9 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.43). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, crash_risk=1.00, complaint_volume=0.30.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Kadu Malleshwara' matched to datameet243=61 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.487).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Kadu Malleshwara for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 24 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
